summary: First iteration testing for PureFit Customs site. All 15 backend pytest cases passed (quotes CRUD with base64 uploads, contact CRUD, 422 validation for missing/invalid fields). All requested frontend flows verified via Playwright: home sections render with all data-testids, navbar links, gallery category filter (12 → 2 items when Weddings selected), testimonials carousel prev/next, WhatsApp floating button links to wa.me/919188108947, quote form submission shows quote-success state and persists to GET /api/quotes, contact form submission persists to GET /api/contact, admin page shows submitted quotes (3) and messages (2) with tab switching working, and mobile menu toggle opens the mobile drawer. No critical or minor bugs found.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside POST handlers (lines 137, 180) but module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined AFTER the routes (line 207). It works because Python only resolves the name at call-time (post import), but it is a code-smell - logger should be defined near the top of the file before route definitions.

action_items: (Optional) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig(...)` above the route definitions in server.py for clarity and to avoid the appearance of forward-reference.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py - logger defined after routes that use it (lines 137, 180 vs definition at 207). Works at runtime but should be reordered.

QuoteRequest model returns the full base64 logo_data / photo_data in the POST /api/quotes response. For large uploads this could bloat responses; consider returning the list-shape (without base64) and providing the data only via GET /api/quotes/{id}. Not blocking.

Admin page is publicly accessible by design per problem statement - confirmed, no leak. However GET /api/quotes/{id} exposes raw base64 PII (logos/photos) without any auth - acceptable per spec but worth flagging.
Backend CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True (server.py line 197-199) - this combination is rejected by some browsers; not an issue here since auth is not used but worth noting.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in the application (admin is intentionally public)
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ prefixed quote requests (TEST_Customer_A, TEST_Customer_B + one TEST_Playwright_User) and 2 contact messages (TEST_Contact_A + TEST_PW_Contact) via tests. These remain in the DB and are visible in /admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_purefit_api.py and exercises all 5 documented endpoints + validation. Frontend uses data-testid attributes consistently. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://events-reimagined.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin page is intentionally public (no auth). Test data is TEST_ prefixed; can be cleaned via direct DB if needed. Gallery filter has framer-motion exit animation so allow ~2s wait after click before counting items.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA - all tests passed.
